title: Mikanda ya Bokolongono ya Mobeli - 9
instructions: Na baposo mibale eleki, mbala boni ozalaki kotungisama na makambo oyo?

questions.text: Kobungisa posa to esengo ya kosala makambo
Koyoka mawa, kobungisa elikya, to kozala na motema se down
Mokakatano ya kolala, kotikala olingi kolala, to kolala mingi
Kozanga posa ya kolia to kolia mingi
Koyoka mabe mpo na yo moko to lokola osilisi yo to libota na yo
Mokakatano ya kotia makanisi na makambo lokola kotanga to kotala televizyo
Kotambola to koloba malembe mingi tii bato bamonaka, to kokesana na yango kozanga kimia koleka momeseno
Makanisi ete ezalaki malamu soki ofa to omisalela mabe
